svg.title: How a task flows through tinderbox, in four layers. 1, always loaded: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, pstack-models.md. 2, router: delivery, which hands off to pr-follow-through, render-qa, visual-qa. 3, method: pstack playbooks, tstack, fl1nt-design, visual-polish-loop. 4, domain kits: vercel-react-best-practices, vercel-composition-patterns, web-design-guidelines, untangle-codebase.
